reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse a REDEFINES whose data-name-2 entry carries an OCCURS clause (elementary or group), accept a data-name-2 subordinate to an OCCURS item, refuse a subscripted data-name-2, and refuse any variable occurrence data item (an ODO table or an item subordinate to one) in the original definition or the redefinition.

reader.notes: 1985's 'variable occurrence data item' (glossary: an ODO entry or an item subordinate to one) is caught by the ODO subject's ancestor climb into a REDEFINES area. Sentence 1 (COBOL1701) and sentence 4 (COBOL0855) are disjoint screens.

refuter.evidence: r5_in_odo.cob: 77 N PIC 9 VALUE 2. 01 R. 05 T OCCURS 1 TO 4 DEPENDING ON N. 10 A PIC XX. 10 B REDEFINES A PIC X. -> --std 85: EXIT 0, L1=a (accepted and run). Same at --std 2023 (EXIT 0, L1=a). A and B are each subordinate to the ODO entry T, so by the 1985 glossary each IS a variable occurrence data item: cite.py OK  §1985:III.2 (2. DEFINITIONS) the text is in the clause [Such an item must contain an OCCURS DEPENDING ON clause in its data description entry, or be subordinate to such an item]. SR5 sentence 4: OK  §1985:VI.5.10.3 SR5 (5.10.3 Syntax Rules) the text is in SR5 [Neither the original definition nor the redefinition can include a variable occurrence data item]. The reader's own requirement says 'refuse any variable occurrence data item (an ODO table or an item subordinate to one) in the original definition or the redefinition'; its probes put the ODO table INSIDE the REDEFINES area (orig, redef, target) but never put the REDEFINES pair INSIDE the ODO table. Code: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/Passes/OdoResolvePass.cs#Run climbs from the ODO subject UPWARD (for a = item; a = a.Parent) testing InRedefinesArea, so a REDEFINES entry subordinate to the ODO table (a descendant) is never seen. Sentence 2 (data-name-2 may be subordinate to an OCCURS item) does not save it: sentence 4 bars the variable case outright. kb/Work search (REDEFINES with variable occurrence / subordinate to DEPENDING): no note for this shape (PB177, PB209, PB577 concern other shapes).
refuter.corrected: a non-conforming verdict (under-rejects; cause b: the same at every edition, the ODO-in-REDEFINES screen OdoResolvePass#Run climbs only the ODO subject's ancestors, so a REDEFINES entry subordinate to an occurs-depending table, itself a variable occurrence data item per §1985:III.2, is accepted). Repro r5_in_odo.cob above; expected a refusal per §1985:VI.5.10.3 SR5 sentence 4; observed EXIT 0 L1=a at --std 85 and --std 2023. The rest of the reader's probes (OCCURS on data-name-2, subscript, ODO inside the area) stand.

adjudication.reason: An item below an OCCURS DEPENDING ON entry is not itself a variable occurrence data item in the rules (kb/Work PB5799). Decided by the 1985 text: §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR1b cannot use the term for every subordinate item, and §1985:VI.5.15.6 GR5 lists the two cases apart; with that meaning the compiler's refusals and acceptances conform.
